role: AK_TEXT (lines and table rows); MODERN_EDITORIAL (the editor's numbers, brackets, note marks and folio references; his footnotes not reproduced)
comment: Frame 162, printed p. 156: the river اسطس concluded; the rivers اطفطيس and اٮحارس from the mountain of entries 921-922, printed اڡيفا and اڡٮڡا, into the marsh; two rivers out of the marsh through the mountain دقيا to the sea; two rivers from the mountain فوقا past the town Ṭarmā into the marsh, which the editor identifies with rivers already described; and the extent of the marsh. The editor's running numbers (٢٣٧٠)-(٢٣٨٠) and the numbers of Suhrāb; letters, words and numerals supplied by the editor between angle brackets. Nine lines of the editor's footnotes.

observations: The river اسطس goes on from p. 155 (frame 161), whose last point, «نهر اسطس من جبل اڡيڡا ⟨ايضاً⟩ اوّله عند طول عٮ ل والعرض ٮه ل (٢٣٦٩) [٢٢٠٢]», L01 continues: «ومصبّه فى البطيحة عند ⟨طول سط ل⟩ والعرض ٮد مه (٢٣٧٠) *», and its mouth in the marsh is at ⟨the longitude 69° 30′⟩ and the latitude ٮد مه.

L01-L05: «نهر اطفطيس من جبل اڡيفا ⟨ايضاً⟩ اوّله عند طول عح {z} والعرض ٮد {z} (٢٣٧١) ومصبّه فى البطيحة عند طول سط ل والعرض ند ك (٢٣٧٢) *», the river اطفطيس, from the mountain اڡيفا ⟨too⟩: its beginning is at the longitude 78° 0′ and the latitude ٮد ō, and its mouth in the marsh at the longitude 69° 30′ and the latitude 54° 20′; «نهر اٮحارس من جبل اڡٮڡا ⟨ايضاً⟩ اوّله عند طول عد {z} والعرض ٮح ل (٢٣٧٣) ومصبّه فى البطيحة عند طول سط {z} والعرض ⟨نج نه⟩ (٢٣٧٤) *», the river اٮحارس, from the mountain اڡٮڡا ⟨too⟩: its beginning is at the longitude 74° 0′ and the latitude ٮح ل, and its mouth in the marsh at the longitude 69° 0′ and the latitude ⟨53° 55′⟩.

The mountain of L02 and L04 is entries 921-922 of the table of the mountains, «جبل افيقا» (frame 068, L15), whose first boundary is at the longitude 78° 0′, the beginning of the river اطفطيس; the editor's note l there gives the forms of the entries (2371) and (2373). L02: «اڡيفا», an alif, a loop without a dot, the low tooth of a ي with its two dots below, a loop with the dot of the ف and a final alif; L04: «اڡٮڡا», the same strokes without any dot. The river names: «اطفطيس» (L02), with the dot of the ف and the two dots of the ي; «اٮحارس» (L03), an alif, a short tooth without a dot, 10 px high, standing apart from the cap of the ح, the ح, an alif, a ر and a final س.

L05-L09: «يخرج من هٰذه البطيحة نهران اوّل احد⟨هما⟩ عند طول سب {z} والعرض ⟨نو ل⟩ (٢٣٧٥) يمرّ ⟨فيقطع⟩ جبل دقيا ويمرّ فيصبّ فى ⟨البحر⟩ ع⟨ند طول⟩ نط ك والعرض س ك (٢٣٧٦) والنهر الثانى اوّله عند طول سح {z} ⟨والعرض نز م⟩ (٢٣٧٧) يمرّ فيقطع جبل دقيا ويمرّ فيصبّ فى البحر عند طول س ل والعرض س ل (٢٣٧٨) *», out of this marsh come two rivers: the beginning of one ⟨of them⟩ is at the longitude 62° 0′ and the latitude ⟨56° 30′⟩; it passes ⟨and cuts through⟩ the mountain دقيا, and passes and flows into ⟨the sea⟩ ⟨at the longitude⟩ 59° 20′ and the latitude 60° 20′; and the second river begins at the longitude 68° 0′ ⟨and the latitude 57° 40′⟩, passes and cuts through the mountain دقيا, and passes and flows into the sea at the longitude 60° 30′ and the latitude 60° 30′.

The mountain «دقيا» (L07, L09), with the two dots of the ق and of the ي, is entries 915-916 of the table of the mountains, «جبل دٮڡا» (frame 068, L12), whose boundaries are at 60° 0′ and ٮر م and at 62° 50′ and ٮط ō (frame 069, L12); the editor's note g there gives the forms of this page. In L07 the ع of «عند» stands before the opening bracket and the editor supplies its letters ند with «طول».

L10-L11: «نهران يخرجان من جبل فوقا ⟨يمرّان ب⟩مدينة طرمى ⟨مماسّين لها⟩ ويصبّان فى البطيحة والمدينة على البطيحة *», two rivers come out of the mountain فوقا; ⟨they pass by⟩ the town Ṭarmā ⟨touching it⟩ and flow into the marsh, and the town is on the marsh. The editor's note o identifies them with the rivers of the points (2192)-(2193) and (2194)-(2195), the river from the mountain قوقا and the river اقسس, both into the marsh beside Ṭarmā (frame 151, L06-L10); here they have no coordinates and no running numbers. «فوقا» has the dot of the ف and the two dots of the ق, the form that the editor's note h on frame 064 records after entry (2378); «⟨يمرّان ب⟩»: within the brackets «يمرّان» and the ب of «بمدينة», with its dot, in its joining form; «مدينة» stands after the note mark l.

L11-L13: «⟨هٰذه⟩ البطيحة اوّلها من طول ٮح ⟨مه⟩ (٢٣٧٩) ⟨الى طول ٮ⟩ط م (٢٣٨٠) يبتدئ من موضع مسيل الأربعة الأنهار على قدر عرض الأربعة ⟨الأنهار . . . . . .⟩ الجانبين حتّى تصير», ⟨this⟩ marsh: its beginning is from the longitude ٮح ⟨مه⟩, ⟨to the longitude⟩ ٮ⟨ط م⟩; it begins from the place where the four rivers flow, as wide as the four ⟨rivers ......⟩ the two sides, until it becomes …, continued on p. 157. Read with ن, 58° 45′ and 59° 40′: 58° 45′ is the longitude of the mouths of the first and of the fourth of the four rivers that go to the marsh (frame 161, L01, L03).

L13: «⟨الأنهار . . . . . .⟩»: within the brackets «الأنهار» and six evenly spaced dots, 8 to 9 px across and about 28 px apart, at the height of the base line, where the editor marks a gap of the manuscript with traces of letters (note s). Transcribed as six dots.

L12: «⟨الى طول ٮ⟩ط م»: the line over the numerals runs from the tooth, within the brackets, to the م; the tooth stands in its joining form at the closing bracket, the note mark q follows the bracket, and the ط, joined from the right, and the minutes stand after it. «ٮح ⟨مه⟩»: the minutes stand within brackets under the same line.

Numerals: «سط ل» (L01, within the brackets; L03), 69° 30′; «عح {z}» (L02), 78° 0′; «ند ك» (L03), with the dot of the ن, 54° 20′; «عد {z}» (L04), 74° 0′; «سط {z}» (L05), 69° 0′; «⟨نج نه⟩» (L05), with the dots of the two ن and the dot in the bowl of the ج, 53° 55′; «سب {z}» (L06), with the dot of the ب, 62° 0′; «⟨نو ل⟩» (L06), 56° 30′; «نط ك» (L07), 59° 20′; «س ك» (L07), 60° 20′; «سح {z}» (L08), 68° 0′; «⟨نز م⟩» (L08), with the dots of the ن and of the ز, 57° 40′; «س ل» (L09, twice), 60° 30′. The ك of «ند ك» (L03), «نط ك» and «س ك» (L07) is the isolated ك with its small inner stroke, 20. The zero sign «{z}» (L02, twice; L04, L05, L06, L08) is a ring under a straight stroke, 47 to 49 px wide.

A tooth without its dot in the degrees of the latitude and of the longitude, transcribed so, which read with ن give: «ٮد مه» (L01), 54° 45′; «ٮد {z}» (L02), 54° 0′; «ٮح ل» (L04), 58° 30′; «ٮح ⟨مه⟩» (L12), 58° 45′; «⟨ٮ⟩ط م» (L12), 59° 40′; read with ي, 14, 18 and 19.
«عح {z}» (L02), «ٮح ل» (L04), «سح {z}» (L08) and «ٮح ⟨مه⟩» (L12): the ح shows no dot in the bowl, where «⟨نج نه⟩» (L05) has the dot of the ج; the same form is a ج without its dot, 3.

Angle brackets, each followed by a note mark, around what the editor supplies: «⟨طول سط ل⟩» (L01), note a; «⟨ايضاً⟩» (L02, L04), both note b; «⟨نج نه⟩» (L05) and «⟨نو ل⟩» (L06), under the lines over the numerals, notes c and e; «⟨هما⟩» (L06), of «احدهما», note d; «⟨فيقطع⟩» (L07), note f; «⟨البحر⟩» and «⟨ند طول⟩» (L07), both note h; «⟨والعرض نز م⟩» (L08), note i; «⟨يمرّان ب⟩» (L10), note l; «⟨مماسّين لها⟩» (L10-L11), note m; «⟨هٰذه⟩» (L11), note p; «⟨مه⟩» and «⟨الى طول ٮ⟩» (L12), both note q; «⟨الأنهار . . . . . .⟩» (L13), note s. Transcribed with the brackets.

Signs in the text, transcribed as printed: «ومصبّه» (L01, L03, L04), «فيصبّ» (L07, L09) and «ويصبّان» (L11) with a shadda over the ب; «ايضاً» (L02, L04) with the tanwin of the accusative over its alif; «اوّله» (L02, L04, L08), «اوّل» (L06) and «اوّلها» (L11) with a shadda over the و; «هٰذه» (L05, L11) with a small alif over the ه; «يمرّ» (L06, L09), «ويمرّ» (L07, L09) and «يمرّان» (L10) with a shadda over the ر; «الثانى» (L08) with the three dots of the ث and a final ى without dots; «مماسّين» (L10) with a shadda over the س; «يبتدئ» (L12) with a hamza over the final ى; «الأربعة» and «الأنهار» (L13) with a hamza over the alif; «حتّى» (L13) with a shadda over the ت; «فى», «على» and «طرمى» end in a ى without dots.

The running numbers run (٢٣٧٠)-(٢٣٨٠) without a gap. The numbers of Suhrāb: [٢٢٠٣]-[٢٢١١] after (٢٣٧٠)-(٢٣٧٨); [١٠٣٥] and [١٠٣٦] after (٢٣٧٩) and (٢٣٨٠), the two ends of the marsh. (٢٣٧٦) [٢٢٠٩] and (٢٣٧٨) [٢٢١١] stand at the beginnings of L08 and L10, and [٢٢١٠] at the beginning of L09, after what ends the lines before.
Asterisks: the small open stars with six points, after [٢٢٠٣] (L01), [٢٢٠٥] (L03), [٢٢٠٧] (L05), [٢٢١١] (L10) and «البطيحة» with the note mark o (L11), are transcribed as asterisks.

Note marks: L01, a after the closing bracket; L02 and L04, b after «⟨ايضاً⟩»; L05, c after «⟨نج نه⟩»; L06, d after «⟨هما⟩» and e after «⟨نو ل⟩»; L07, f after «⟨فيقطع⟩», g after «دقيا» and h after «⟨البحر⟩» and after «⟨ند طول⟩»; L08, i after the closing bracket; L09, k after «دقيا»; L10, l after «⟨يمرّان ب⟩»; L11, m after «لها⟩», n after «فى», o after the second «البطيحة» and p after «⟨هٰذه⟩»; L12, q after «⟨مه⟩» and after «ٮ⟩»; L13, r after «الأنهار» and after the second «الأربعة», and s after the closing bracket.
Marks not transcribed: small specks of the impression, among them specks of 13 to 15 px under the lines over «ٮد مه» (L01) and «عد {z}» and «ٮح ل» (L04), smaller than the dots of the font.

The editor's footnotes stand in nine lines below a short rule at the left: notes a-s; note b serves the brackets of L02 and L04, h the two of L07, q the two of L12 and r both marks of L13. The page number «— ١٥٦ —» stands at the foot, centred.
